=== references to symbols in their own section, by binding
        .text
        .globl  glob, hid, prot, intl, galias, func
        .hidden hid
        .protected prot
        .internal intl
        .weak   weak1, walias, whid
        .hidden whid
        .type   func, %function
        .hidden lhid
start:
        bsr loc
        bsr glob
        bsr weak1
        bsr hid
        bsr prot
        bsr intl
        bsr whid
        bsr lhid
        bsr func
        bsr late
        bsr lweak
        bsr lalias
        bsr lwalias
        bsr galias
        bsr walias
        jbsr loc
        jbsr glob
        jbsr weak1
        jbsr lalias
        jbsr walias
        jra loc
        jra glob
        jra weak1
        jra lalias
        jra walias
        beq loc
        beq glob
        beq weak1
        beq lalias
        beq walias
        lea loc(%pc), %a0
        lea glob(%pc), %a0
        lea weak1(%pc), %a0
        lea lalias(%pc), %a0
        lea galias(%pc), %a0
        nop
loc:    nop
glob:   nop
weak1:  nop
hid:    nop
prot:   nop
intl:   nop
whid:   nop
lhid:   nop
func:   nop
late:   nop
lweak:  nop
        .globl  late
        .weak   lweak
        .set    lalias, glob
        .set    lwalias, weak1
        .set    galias, loc
        .set    walias, loc

=== references back to symbols in their own section
        .text
        .globl  glob
        .weak   weak1
loc:    nop
glob:   nop
weak1:  nop
        .set    lalias, glob
        bsr loc
        bsr glob
        bsr weak1
        bsr lalias
        jbsr loc
        jbsr glob
        jbsr weak1
        jra loc
        jra glob
        jra weak1
        beq loc
        beq glob
        beq weak1

=== references out of their section, by binding
        .text
        .globl  oglob
        .weak   oweak, uweak
        .set    oalias, oloc
        bsr oloc
        bsr oglob
        bsr oweak
        bsr oalias
        bsr ext
        bsr uweak
        nop
        .section .text.other,"ax"
oloc:   nop
oglob:  nop
oweak:  nop

=== data referring to symbols, by binding
        .data
        .globl  glob, galias, hid
        .weak   weak1, walias
        .weak   uweak
        .hidden hid
        .set    lalias, glob
        .set    lwalias, weak1
        .set    galias, loc
        .set    walias, loc
base:   .long   loc, glob, weak1, hid, lalias, lwalias, galias, walias, ext
        .long   loc - ., glob - ., weak1 - ., lalias - ., walias - .
        .long   glob - base, weak1 - base, base - weak1, lalias - base, walias - base
        .long   ext - ., uweak - .
loc:    .long   0
glob:   .long   0
weak1:  .long   0
hid:    .long   0

=== default section alignment
        .text
        .byte   1
        .data
        .byte   2
        .section .rodata
        .byte   3
        .bss
        .space  1
        .section .text.hot,"ax"
        .byte   4
        .section .data.rel,"aw"
        .byte   5
        .section .init,"ax"
        .byte   6
        .section custom,"a"
        .byte   7

=== FPU and MMU operands referring to symbols
        .text
        .globl  glob
start:
        fmovex  ext,%fp0
        faddd   ext+8,%fp1
        fmoves  %fp2,ext
        fmovex  ext(%pc),%fp3
        fmovex  ext(%pc,%d0:l),%fp4
        fmovel  #ext,%fpcr
        fbeq    ext
        fbnel   glob
        fjgt    ext
        fdbne   %d0,ext
        ftrapeql #ext
        pmove   ext,%tc
        pbbs    ext
        pdbbc   %d1,ext
        callm   #ext,(%a0)
        cas2l   %d0:%d1,%d2:%d3,(%a0):(%a1)
        movepw  %d0,8(%a1)
glob:   rts
        .data
        .long   ext
=== DBcc to other sections and undefined symbols
        .text
        dbra    %d0,ext
        dbne    %d1,other
        dbeq    %d2,here
here:   rts
        .section .text.b,"ax",@progbits
other:  rts
=== refused: an FPU instruction without an FPU
        .arch   68000
        faddx   %fp0,%fp1
=== refused: a 68851 instruction on a 68040
        .arch   68040
        pmove   %tc,%a0@
=== refused: move16 on a 68030
        .arch   68030
        move16  %a0@+,%a1@+
=== refused: callm beyond the 68020
        .arch   68030
        callm   #0,%a0@
=== refused: a ColdFire instruction on a 68060
        .arch   68060
        mvsw    %d0,%d1
=== refused: a movec register the CPU does not have
        .arch   68010
        movec   %d0,%cacr
=== .arch picks the CPU, as -march and -mcpu do
        .arch   68040
        move16  ext,%a0@
        cinva   %ic
        pflush  %a1@
        fsaddx  %fp0,%fp1
=== .arch with an extension after a comma
        .arch   68000,68881
        faddx   %fp0,%fp1
        fbeq    ext
        jra     ext
=== .cpu names a part rather than an architecture
        .cpu    68332
        bgnd
